caption: "resident evil movie" — 500,000+ searches this week. Swipe for 10 things most people don't know about the reboot critics finally like.

Why: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil opened in the US on September 18 with 95% on Rotten Tomatoes, the best score any video game film has had. Friday took $26.3 million, nearly the old franchise record for a whole weekend.

What most people don't know: the game was never meant to be called Resident Evil. In Japan it is Biohazard; Capcom renamed it for the West in 1996 because the name was taken. It has sold 213 million games, and the six earlier films made over $1 billion.
Very simply put: eighth film, the first one critics actually like.

slides.headline: It opened September 18 with *95%* on Rotten Tomatoes.
slides.sub: Earlier films scored 18% to 37%. Metacritic 81, CinemaScore B+.
slides.image: Rows of empty red cinema seats facing a glowing white screen, seats in the upper half of the frame, lower half plain dark floor, photorealistic, no people, no text

slides.headline: Friday alone: *$26.3 million*.
slides.sub: The old franchise record was $26.6 million for a whole weekend (Afterlife, 2010). Budget: $75 million.
slides.image: A stack of paper cinema tickets on a glass counter under warm light, tickets in the upper half of the frame, lower half plain glass, photorealistic, no readable text

slides.headline: The director made *Barbarian* and *Weapons*.
slides.sub: Zach Cregger co-wrote this one with Shay Hatten. Shot in Prague from October 2025 to January 2026.
slides.image: A film clapperboard resting on a director's chair on a dark empty sound stage, clapperboard in the upper half of the frame, lower half plain dark floor, photorealistic, no readable text

slides.headline: It is not based on any game's *plot*.
slides.sub: An original story: a medical courier crossing Raccoon City during the outbreak, alongside the events of Resident Evil 2.
slides.image: A courier's insulated medical cooler box on the seat of an old car at night, box in the upper half of the frame, lower half plain dark seat, photorealistic, no logos, no text

slides.headline: Netflix already tried: an *eight-episode* series in 2022.
slides.sub: It premiered July 14, 2022, across two timelines. There are animated films too, starting in 2008.
slides.image: A television glowing in a dark living room with a remote on the sofa arm, television in the upper half of the frame, lower half plain dark carpet, photorealistic, no logos, no text

slides.headline: *213 million* games sold.
slides.sub: As of June 2026, Capcom's best-selling franchise and the tenth best-selling game series ever.
slides.image: A vintage grey game console with a controller on a white desk in bright light, console in the upper half of the frame, lower half plain white, photorealistic, no logos, no text

slides.headline: The six earlier films made over *$1 billion*.
slides.sub: Paul W. S. Anderson directed all six between 2002 and 2016, the most successful film series based on a game.
